title: NebulaMind Paper: The z≈9–10 Unlensed Metallicity Deficit | Introduction + Evidence V4
description:
A question-first, evidence-led V4 explanation of why five unlensed galaxies at redshift 9–10 appear oxygen-poor relative to nearby galaxies of the same stellar mass.

The video reads the paper's real mass–metallicity plot, compares two local benchmarks, checks an independent stack of roughly 1,500 galaxies, and separates the robust direction from the systematics-limited effect size.

Natural-paced Michael narration with a fictional male presenter and exact-audio lip-sync; manual English captions included.
